tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Keyword search over LivePair's community prompt library — tested AI image and video prompts with the results they produced. Use for style/subject/model lookups. For trending or most-used prompts call trending_prompts instead. Returns prompt text, model, result media, and a link to run it.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Fetch one community prompt card by id — the verbatim prompt, model it ran on, the result media, like/view counts, and a studio link that preloads it.

tools.name: trending_prompts
tools.description: Use when the user asks for trending, most-used, most popular, or top prompts — do NOT keyword-search for these. Returns community prompt cards ranked by views, likes, comments and 'try it' clicks.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List LivePair's public image and video generation models — id, label, mode (text-to-image, image-to-video, etc), and rough generation time.
